NASB.1: 'Now if his offering is a sacrifice of peace offerings, if he is going to offer out of the herd, whether male or female, he shall offer it without defect before the LORD.
NASB.2: 'He shall lay his hand on the head of his offering and slay it at the doorway of the tent of meeting, and Aaron's sons the priests shall sprinkle the blood around on the altar.
NASB.3: 'From the sacrifice of the peace offerings he shall present an offering by fire to the LORD, the fat that covers the entrails and all the fat that is on the entrails,
NASB.4: and the two kidneys with the fat that is on them, which is on the loins, and the lobe of the liver, which he shall remove with the kidneys.
NASB.5: 'Then Aaron's sons shall offer [it] up in smoke on the altar on the burnt offering, which is on the wood that is on the fire; it is an offering by fire of a soothing aroma to the LORD.
NASB.6: 'But if his offering for a sacrifice of peace offerings to the LORD is from the flock, he shall offer it, male or female, without defect.
NASB.7: 'If he is going to offer a lamb for his offering, then he shall offer it before the LORD,
NASB.8: and he shall lay his hand on the head of his offering and slay it before the tent of meeting, and Aaron's sons shall sprinkle its blood around on the altar.
NASB.9: 'From the sacrifice of peace offerings he shall bring as an offering by fire to the LORD, its fat, the entire fat tail which he shall remove close to the backbone, and the fat that covers the entrails and all the fat that is on the entrails,
NASB.10: and the two kidneys with the fat that is on them, which is on the loins, and the lobe of the liver, which he shall remove with the kidneys.
NASB.11: 'Then the priest shall offer [it] up in smoke on the altar [as] food, an offering by fire to the LORD.
NASB.12: 'Moreover, if his offering is a goat, then he shall offer it before the LORD,
NASB.13: and he shall lay his hand on its head and slay it before the tent of meeting, and the sons of Aaron shall sprinkle its blood around on the altar.
NASB.14: 'From it he shall present his offering as an offering by fire to the LORD, the fat that covers the entrails and all the fat that is on the entrails,
NASB.15: and the two kidneys with the fat that is on them, which is on the loins, and the lobe of the liver, which he shall remove with the kidneys.
NASB.16: 'The priest shall offer them up in smoke on the altar [as] food, an offering by fire for a soothing aroma; all fat is the LORD'S.
NASB.17: 'It is a perpetual statute throughout your generations in all your dwellings: you shall not eat any fat or any blood.''

NKJV.1: ‘When his offering is a sacrifice of a peace offering, if he offers it of the herd, whether male or female, he shall offer it without blemish before the LORD.
NKJV.2: And he shall lay his hand on the head of his offering, and kill it at the door of the tabernacle of meeting; and Aaron’s sons, the priests, shall sprinkle the blood all around on the altar.
NKJV.3: Then he shall offer from the sacrifice of the peace offering an offering made by fire to the LORD. The fat that covers the entrails and all the fat that is on the entrails,
NKJV.4: the two kidneys and the fat that is on them by the flanks, and the fatty lobe attached to the liver above the kidneys, he shall remove;
NKJV.5: and Aaron’s sons shall burn it on the altar upon the burnt sacrifice, which is on the wood that is on the fire, as an offering made by fire, a sweet aroma to the LORD.
NKJV.6: ‘If his offering as a sacrifice of a peace offering to the LORD is of the flock, whether male or female, he shall offer it without blemish.
NKJV.7: If he offers a lamb as his offering, then he shall offer it before the LORD.
NKJV.8: And he shall lay his hand on the head of his offering, and kill it before the tabernacle of meeting; and Aaron’s sons shall sprinkle its blood all around on the altar.
NKJV.9: ‘Then he shall offer from the sacrifice of the peace offering, as an offering made by fire to the LORD, its fat and the whole fat tail which he shall remove close to the backbone. And the fat that covers the entrails and all the fat that is on the entrails,
NKJV.10: the two kidneys and the fat that is on them by the flanks, and the fatty lobe attached to the liver above the kidneys, he shall remove;
NKJV.11: and the priest shall burn them on the altar as food, an offering made by fire to the LORD.
NKJV.12: ‘And if his offering is a goat, then he shall offer it before the LORD.
NKJV.13: He shall lay his hand on its head and kill it before the tabernacle of meeting; and the sons of Aaron shall sprinkle its blood all around on the altar.
NKJV.14: Then he shall offer from it his offering, as an offering made by fire to the LORD. The fat that covers the entrails and all the fat that is on the entrails,
NKJV.15: the two kidneys and the fat that is on them by the flanks, and the fatty lobe attached to the liver above the kidneys, he shall remove;
NKJV.16: and the priest shall burn them on the altar as food, an offering made by fire for a sweet aroma; all the fat is the LORD’s.
NKJV.17: ‘This shall be a perpetual statute throughout your generations in all your dwellings: you shall eat neither fat nor blood.’ ”

ESV.2: And he shall lay his hand on the head of his offering and kill it at the entrance of the tent of meeting, and Aaron's sons the priests shall throw the blood against the sides of the altar.
ESV.3: And from the sacrifice of the peace offering, as a food offering to the LORD, he shall offer the fat covering the entrails and all the fat that is on the entrails,
ESV.4: and the two kidneys with the fat that is on them at the loins, and the long lobe of the liver that he shall remove with the kidneys.
ESV.5: Then Aaron's sons shall burn it on the altar on top of the burnt offering, which is on the wood on the fire; it is a food offering with a pleasing aroma to the LORD.

ESV.9: Then from the sacrifice of the peace offering he shall offer as a food offering to the LORD its fat; he shall remove the whole fat tail, cut off close to the backbone, and the fat that covers the entrails and all the fat that is on the entrails
ESV.10: and the two kidneys with the fat that is on them at the loins and the long lobe of the liver that he shall remove with the kidneys.
ESV.11: And the priest shall burn it on the altar as a food offering to the LORD.
ESV.12: “If his offering is a goat, then he shall offer it before the LORD
ESV.13: and lay his hand on its head and kill it in front of the tent of meeting, and the sons of Aaron shall throw its blood against the sides of the altar.
ESV.14: Then he shall offer from it, as his offering for a food offering to the LORD, the fat covering the entrails and all the fat that is on the entrails
ESV.15: and the two kidneys with the fat that is on them at the loins and the long lobe of the liver that he shall remove with the kidneys.
ESV.16: And the priest shall burn them on the altar as a food offering with a pleasing aroma. All fat is the LORD's.
ESV.17: It shall be a statute forever throughout your generations, in all your dwelling places, that you eat neither fat nor blood.”

NLT.1: “If you present an animal from the herd as a peace offering to the LORD, it may be a male or a female, but it must have no defects.
NLT.2: Lay your hand on the animal’s head, and slaughter it at the entrance of the Tabernacle. Then Aaron’s sons, the priests, will splatter its blood against all sides of the altar.
NLT.3: The priest must present part of this peace offering as a special gift to the LORD. This includes all the fat around the internal organs,
NLT.4: the two kidneys and the fat around them near the loins, and the long lobe of the liver. These must be removed with the kidneys,
NLT.5: and Aaron’s sons will burn them on top of the burnt offering on the wood burning on the altar. It is a special gift, a pleasing aroma to the LORD.
NLT.6: “If you present an animal from the flock as a peace offering to the LORD, it may be a male or a female, but it must have no defects.
NLT.7: If you present a sheep as your offering, bring it to the LORD,
NLT.8: lay your hand on its head, and slaughter it in front of the Tabernacle. Aaron’s sons will then splatter the sheep’s blood against all sides of the altar.
NLT.9: The priest must present the fat of this peace offering as a special gift to the LORD. This includes the fat of the broad tail cut off near the backbone, all the fat around the internal organs,
NLT.10: the two kidneys and the fat around them near the loins, and the long lobe of the liver. These must be removed with the kidneys,
NLT.11: and the priest will burn them on the altar. It is a special gift of food presented to the LORD.
NLT.12: “If you present a goat as your offering, bring it to the LORD,
NLT.13: lay your hand on its head, and slaughter it in front of the Tabernacle. Aaron’s sons will then splatter the goat’s blood against all sides of the altar.
NLT.14: The priest must present part of this offering as a special gift to the LORD. This includes all the fat around the internal organs,
NLT.15: the two kidneys and the fat around them near the loins, and the long lobe of the liver. These must be removed with the kidneys,
NLT.16: and the priest will burn them on the altar. It is a special gift of food, a pleasing aroma to the LORD. All the fat belongs to the LORD.
NLT.17: “You must never eat any fat or blood. This is a permanent law for you, and it must be observed from generation to generation, wherever you live.”

AMP.1: 'If a man's offering is a sacrifice of peace offerings, if he offers an animal from the herd, whether male or female, he shall offer it without blemish before the LORD.
AMP.2: He shall lay his hand on the head of his offering [transferring symbolically his guilt to the sacrifice] and kill it at the doorway of the Tent of Meeting; and Aaron's sons the priests shall sprinkle the blood around on the altar.
AMP.3: From the sacrifice of the peace offerings, an offering by fire to the LORD, he shall present the fat that covers the entrails, and all the fat which is on the entrails,
AMP.4: and the two kidneys with the fat that is on them at the loins, and the lobe of the liver which he shall remove with the kidneys.
AMP.5: Aaron's sons shall offer it up in smoke on the altar [placing it] on the burnt offering which is on the wood that is on the fire. It is an offering by fire, a sweet and soothing aroma to the LORD.
AMP.6: If his peace offering to the LORD is an animal from the flock, male or female, he shall offer the animal without blemish.
AMP.7: If he offers a lamb as his offering, then he shall present it before the LORD,
AMP.8: and he shall lay his hand on the head of his offering and kill it before the Tent of Meeting, and Aaron's sons shall sprinkle its blood around on the altar.
AMP.9: From the sacrifice of peace offerings he shall bring as an offering by fire to the LORD, its fat, the entire fat tail which he shall remove close to the backbone, and the fat that covers the entrails, and all the fat which is on the entrails,
AMP.10: and the two kidneys with the fat that is on them at the loins, and the lobe of the liver, which he shall remove with the kidneys.
AMP.11: The priest shall offer it up in smoke on the altar as food, an offering by fire to the LORD.
AMP.12: 'If his offering is a goat, he shall present it before the LORD,
AMP.13: and he shall lay his hand on its head [transferring symbolically his guilt to the sacrifice], and kill it before the Tent of Meeting; and the sons of Aaron shall sprinkle its blood around on the altar.
AMP.14: Then he shall present from it as his offering, an offering by fire to the LORD: the fat that covers the entrails, and all the fat that is on the entrails,
AMP.15: and the two kidneys with the fat that is on them at the loins, and the lobe of the liver which he shall remove with the kidneys.
AMP.16: The priest shall offer them up in smoke on the altar as food. It is an offering by fire, a sweet and soothing aroma; all the fat is the Lord's.
AMP.17: It is a permanent statute for your generations wherever you may be, that you shall not eat any fat or any blood.'"

NIV.1:
The Fellowship Offering
“‘If someone’s offering is a fellowship offering, and he offers an animal from the herd, whether male or female, he is to present before the Lord an animal without defect.
NIV.2: He is to lay his hand on the head of his offering and slaughter it at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting. Then Aaron’s sons the priests shall sprinkle the blood against the altar on all sides.
NIV.3: From the fellowship offering he is to bring a sacrifice made to the Lord by fire: all the fat that covers the inner parts or is connected to them,
NIV.4: both kidneys with the fat on them near the loins, and the covering of the liver, which he will remove with the kidneys.
NIV.5: Then Aaron’s sons are to burn it on the altar on top of the burnt offering that is on the burning wood, as an offering made by fire, an aroma pleasing to the Lord.
NIV.6: “‘If he offers an animal from the flock as a fellowship offering to the Lord, he is to offer a male or female without defect.
NIV.7: If he offers a lamb, he is to present it before the Lord.
NIV.8: He is to lay his hand on the head of his offering and slaughter it in front of the Tent of Meeting. Then Aaron’s sons shall sprinkle its blood against the altar on all sides.
NIV.9: From the fellowship offering he is to bring a sacrifice made to the Lord by fire: its fat, the entire fat tail cut off close to the backbone, all the fat that covers the inner parts or is connected to them,
NIV.10: both kidneys with the fat on them near the loins, and the covering of the liver, which he will remove with the kidneys.
NIV.11: The priest shall burn them on the altar as food, an offering made to the Lord by fire.
NIV.12: “‘If his offering is a goat, he is to present it before the Lord.
NIV.13: He is to lay his hand on its head and slaughter it in front of the Tent of Meeting. Then Aaron’s sons shall sprinkle its blood against the altar on all sides.
NIV.14: From what he offers he is to make this offering to the Lord by fire: all the fat that covers the inner parts or is connected to them,
NIV.15: both kidneys with the fat on them near the loins, and the covering of the liver, which he will remove with the kidneys.
NIV.16: The priest shall burn them on the altar as food, an offering made by fire, a pleasing aroma. All the fat is the Lord’s.
NIV.17: “‘This is a lasting ordinance for the generations to come, wherever you live: You must not eat any fat or any blood.’”

NRSVCE.1: If the offering is a sacrifice of well-being, if you offer an animal of the herd, whether male or female, you shall offer one without blemish before the LORD.
NRSVCE.2: You shall lay your hand on the head of the offering and slaughter it at the entrance of the tent of meeting; and Aaron’s sons the priests shall dash the blood against all sides of the altar.
NRSVCE.3: You shall offer from the sacrifice of well-being, as an offering by fire to the LORD, the fat that covers the entrails and all the fat that is around the entrails;
NRSVCE.4: the two kidneys with the fat that is on them at the loins, and the appendage of the liver, which he shall remove with the kidneys.
NRSVCE.5: Then Aaron’s sons shall turn these into smoke on the altar, with the burnt offering that is on the wood on the fire, as an offering by fire of pleasing odor to the LORD.
NRSVCE.6: If your offering for a sacrifice of well-being to the LORD is from the flock, male or female, you shall offer one without blemish.
NRSVCE.7: If you present a sheep as your offering, you shall bring it before the LORD
NRSVCE.8: and lay your hand on the head of the offering. It shall be slaughtered before the tent of meeting, and Aaron’s sons shall dash its blood against all sides of the altar.
NRSVCE.9: You shall present its fat from the sacrifice of well-being, as an offering by fire to the LORD: the whole broad tail, which shall be removed close to the backbone, the fat that covers the entrails, and all the fat that is around the entrails;
NRSVCE.10: the two kidneys with the fat that is on them at the loins, and the appendage of the liver, which you shall remove with the kidneys.
NRSVCE.11: Then the priest shall turn these into smoke on the altar as a food offering by fire to the LORD.
NRSVCE.12: If your offering is a goat, you shall bring it before the LORD
NRSVCE.13: and lay your hand on its head; it shall be slaughtered before the tent of meeting; and the sons of Aaron shall dash its blood against all sides of the altar.
NRSVCE.14: You shall present as your offering from it, as an offering by fire to the LORD, the fat that covers the entrails, and all the fat that is around the entrails;
NRSVCE.15: the two kidneys with the fat that is on them at the loins, and the appendage of the liver, which you shall remove with the kidneys.
NRSVCE.16: Then the priest shall turn these into smoke on the altar as a food offering by fire for a pleasing odor. All fat is the LORD’s.
NRSVCE.17: It shall be a perpetual statute throughout your generations, in all your settlements: you must not eat any fat or any blood.
